flags.why: Viên names Vienna but does not mean a Viennese person or the adjective Viennese.
Ờ does not mean no; in this example, không supplies the negation and ờ is a hesitation ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/ờ,3,0,0.html)).
flags.fix: Remove sense 3; its example belongs under sense 2.

flags.why: Giao bóng means to serve the ball into play, rather than pass it to a teammate ([physical education textbook](https://ydmekong.edu.vn/public/upload/files/Library/Giao%20duc%20the%20chat_TC.pdf)).
The example incorrectly uses giao bóng for an ordinary football pass.
flags.fix: Cô ấy giao bóng rất mạnh. = She serves the ball very powerfully.

flags.why: The entry omits the common everyday meaning of food having gone bad.
flags.fix: adj | spoiled; gone bad (of food). Ex: Thức ăn này hỏng rồi. = This food has gone bad.

flags.why: Tập meaning an exercise book is chiefly Southern usage and needs a regional warning ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tập)).
Tập denotes a bundle of paper without specifying the fixed quantity implied by ream ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tập)).
Năm tập giấy specifies five bundles of paper, not necessarily five reams.
flags.fix: The office has just bought five bundles of A4 paper.

flags.why: Tập means an instalment and does not itself mean prequel or sequel.
